title: Ndax launches flexible crypto staking
description: Ndax announced that its first flexible crypto staking program was available starting 15 February 2022, initially supporting ETH, DOT and ADA.
notes: First-party Ndax launch material explicitly says staking was starting that day and describes it as the company's first flexible crypto staking program.

title: VALR officially launches crypto staking
description: VALR announced the official launch of crypto staking on 27 June 2023, initially supporting Solana and Avalanche.
notes: First-party VALR launch material explicitly identifies 27 June 2023 as the official staking launch date.
